avis.titre: Love this and would definitely buy again
avis.texte: Loved this product and definitely will buy again. very hydrating
This gave me the biggest allergic reaction. It said to leave it on For 3- 4 hours I couldn't do it. I left it on for 1 hour and it was horrible!!

avis.titre: First time using a hydrating mask
avis.texte: My first time using a hydrating facial mask. The salesperson assisting for my visit suggested it when I asked. It was easy to use and my face felt amazing afterward. I also noticed a glow which I also enjoyed.

Love this! The fit was hard for me to get right but because I didn't get a part of my cheek covered on one side I could actually see a difference in my skin! My pores were much tighter with the mask and the results lasted a week. At the great price point I'd like to make it a regular part of my routine
This mask refreshed my face so much. After wearing overnight and removing, my skin was so soft and my face looked hydrated. Will continue to use.
Nothing compares to this face mask. i even bought some for my bf!

This was my first time trying this face masks & let me tell you I LOVED IT!! My face has never been this glowyyyy before omg and it helped out with my eyebags girl love love & most def going to get some more !

I receive this mask complimentary from TONYMOLY and gifted by TONYMOLY in exchange for my honest review on their products. I'm grateful this product exists because I now have a product to rejuvenate my skin especially in the winter.

This mask was gifted by tonymoly in exchange for my honest review. I genuinely enjoyed using it — it feels cooling and soothing on the skin, and by morning it completely absorbs, leaving my forehead smooth, firm, and refreshed. My skin looked more plump and hydrated, and I could really see the "glass skin" effect. A great overnight treatment I'd happily use again.

I absolutely love this overnight mask. It makes my skin look so good in the morning. Its super moisturizing and makes my skin look so much smoother and so much softer. Super good for dry winter skin. Gifted by tonymoly

This is really easy to apply and use - the lining on the mask makes it. It feels soft and natural; the mask doesn't freeze your face too much. When I woke up, I removed the mask and my skin was soft and hydrated. Gifted by tonymoly

Holy moly this mask is like magic!! You put it on before bed and wake up looking like glass, unreal. It's gentle on my sensitive skin and doesn't slide or move in my sleep. Complimentary from tonymoly!

This mask was really comfortable to fit my face. It's in 2 different parts so you can layer it so it fits perfectly. I felt like the product really saturated my skin because I kept the mask on for a while. Gifted by TonyMoly.

Gifted by Tonymoly, I love how easy the mask is to put on and that it's separated into pieces so you can apply the lower half first and then the upper half. I wore the mask overnight and what I like about this mask is different than other ones is that underneath the eyes it sits a little bit higher so my under eyes were also moisturized in the morning too. I did think the mass was going to melt away into the skin by the morning time, but it didn't it just kind of hardened a bit, but nevertheless, the results were still really nice.

avis.titre: BROUGHT MY SKIN BACK TO LIFE!!
avis.texte: I was genuinely surprised with how this mask brought my dry face back to life. My skin was so hydrated and looked so good after I used it. I will be purchasing some for the winter because my sling gets really dry. Gifted by tonymoly

I received this product complimentary from Tony Moly. I really enjoyed this mask. As the weather cools down, I feel that my skin is getting a bit dryer and this mask helped hydrate my skin. I see a huge difference in overall feel and how my makeup applies. I also like how the gel mask lays over the skin so easily compared to a sheet mask.

This product was gifted for free , this mask had my face looking like glass upon waking up. I noticed that the face mask was very comfortable when I was sleeping and not wet as I imagined. The mask fits perfectly as I actually have a small head and some masks do not fit properly on the face but this one fit nice and snug and did not slip off the face. I am a STOMACH sleeper so imagine how hard for this mask to stay on my face and actually stay and keep snug and not move all night long. This mask is a 10 out of 10 because of the way it fit while I slept. I had glass skin for a full day and putting on sunscreen it made your face even more glowy , gifted by tonymoly

Finally Tonymoly came out with one of these masks! I love the hydration and glass skin this gives you and it doesn't slide around. It fits my face perfectly and really helps to calm and plump my skin. Gifted by Tonymoly

I love these masks! They feel super cooling and comfy on the skin! When I woke up, my skin felt smoother and looked really fresh and glowy. I just put it on and left it while I slept! They stayed on really well! Gifted by Tony moly

Super hydrating and easy to use! I used this for a couple hours, even eating, and it stayed on. After the removal, my skin was nice and plump. Only used once so not too sure about strengthening barrier, but fun to use as it does become clear as an indicator to take off. Gifted by TonyMoly.

avis.titre: Love how glowy my skin feels after !
avis.texte: I received this mask by tonymoly in exchange for an honest review. First off, the mask fits pretty good and immediately feels very cooling to the face. The only thing i wish was different was that the mask was absorbed and meshed more to the face during the night so that Its easier to sleep with. Otherwise, i love how this made my skin feel in the morning ! This was gifted by tonymoly.

Complimentary from Tonymoly absolutely love this mask and how low effort it is. I put it on before I went to bed and I woke up with my skin, totally refreshed and rejuvenated. It was super hydrating and made my skin feel amazing.

i received this product for free. i love this mask, very hydrating and gives me glass skin after. it's like the biodance ones but way more affordable, i would def try the others. gifted by tonymoly !!!

Packaging is super cute and I really love how this mask left my skin feeling overnight. I used it during a girls night over and it was just super adorable to wear and take pictures. Will totally be buying again! Complimentary from tonymoly

I love Hydrogel masks. You have to put them on for 3-4 hrs until they dry but they really make the skin glow. This Tony Moly Hydrogel mask is the same. Gives beautiful hydrated skin in a few hrs. Complimentary from Tony Moly

I received this gifted by tonymoly but I was absolutely shocked by how soft this made my skin! I wore it without any extra products underneath and it was like I had done my entire nighttime routine, but I had skipped it for this mask. My skin was so moisturized! And I only wore it for about three hours too! For the entire day after I was shocked by how much more hydrated my skin was. And I have sensitive skin too and it just calmed down any irritation I had before. My make lay so beautifully the next day, so I will be getting this to prep for all my special events! This mask was a dream!

I am in love with this mask. It feel so refreshing on my skin. It definitely makes it look glossy and I can see how my face absorbs all the ingredients. My face feels so hydrated and it's very comfortable to use. Gifted by tonymoly

I got this one mask and it came in a huge box but anyways the mask was great. Loved using it. It stuck to my skin and didn't fall off all night which is exactly what you want for an overnight mask lol Complimentary from tonymoly

This hydrogel mask is a game-changer for tired, dehydrated skin. It locks in moisture, stays perfectly in place all night, and leaves my face feeling soft, smooth, and noticeably plumper by morning. I love how refreshing and soothing it feels, almost like a mini spa treatment while I sleep. For the price, it's such a great value and definitely one of the best recovery masks I've tried. Gifted by tonymoly.

I love these masks, I've repurchased multiple times and they never disappoint. My skin feels hydrated and refreshed immediately after! I have sensitive skin and the masks don't bother me at all! Gifted by tonymoly

I recently tried the new Tonymoly Mask, Melt & Glow Mask Melt Hydrogel Mask collection and I'm seriously impressed. These masks feel like a step up from the typical sheet mask experience. The hydrogel texture adheres perfectly to the skin without sliding around, delivering a cooling, spa-like feel. Each mask in the collection is infused with skin-loving ingredients that leave my face feeling hydrated, plump, and refreshed. I especially loved how the essence absorbs into my skin — no sticky residue, just a smooth, bouncy finish with a healthy glow. The "melt" aspect is so unique: as the mask warms to your skin, it seems to dissolve slightly, helping the active ingredients penetrate more effectively. After using it, my skin looked instantly brighter and felt soothed, especially around the cheeks and forehead. Packaging-wise, Tonymoly nailed it — colorful, fun, and very on-brand. It's also easy to open, and the mask comes with plenty of essence. If you're looking for a mask that hydrates deeply and gives you that K-beauty glow, this is a must-try. Great for self-care nights, travel prep, or any time your skin feels dull or dehydrated. Gifted by tonymoly

Gifted by tonymoly This sheet mask is amazing! It left my skin so hydrated and plump, and I noticed an instant glow after using it. The hyaluronic acid really makes my skin feel refreshed without being sticky. Perfect for a quick self-care boost!

This mask left my skin super hydrated, smooth, and noticeably plumper after one use. I have sensitive, combo skin and had zero irritation—just a calm, refreshed glow. My pores looked smaller, and the hydration really lasted. Great for a quick skin reset or post-workout pick-me-up. Gifted by tonymoly
